llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must run animation-critical computation in UI-runtime worklets (for example `useDerivedValue`/worklet functions) over shared values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedReaction and useAnimatedStyle run on the UI thread as worklets over the shared value `progress`; checkpoint index computation occurs inside the reaction worklet every frame.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must dispatch start/stop or control worklet functions from React runtime using `scheduleOnUI(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnUI`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Code uses `withTiming` from react-native-reanimated to drive animation and never calls `scheduleOnUI` from react-native-worklets. `react-native-worklets` is not even listed as a dependency.
evidence: App.tsx: progress.value = withTiming(...) — no scheduleOnUI call anywhere

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must bridge UI-runtime checkpoint updates back to React via `scheduleOnRN(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Bridging back to React uses the deprecated `runOnJS` from react-native-reanimated, not `scheduleOnRN` from react-native-worklets.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must gate `scheduleOnRN(...)` behind explicit bucket/checkpoint logic in a UI worklet reaction (for example `useAnimatedReaction`) instead of calling it every frame.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedReaction gates the bridge call behind checkpoint-index comparison (`clampedIdx > lastReportedIndex.value`), ensuring at most 5 bridge crossings per animation run instead of every frame.
evidence: App.tsx: if (clampedIdx > lastReportedIndex.value) { lastReportedIndex.value = clampedIdx; runOnJS(onCheckpoint)(clampedIdx) }
